privacyDisclosure.title: Your privacy
privacyDisclosure.body: We don't run analytics or advertising trackers. Your wallet address, theme, and recent activity are stored locally in this browser only.

swapkit.title: Swap
swapkit.subtitle: Cross-chain crypto-to-crypto
swapkit.slippageHelp: Higher tolerance = more likely to succeed but worse rate. 1% is good for single-chain stable swaps; 3-5% for cross-chain.
swapkit.footnote: Powered by SwapKit. Liquidity from THORChain, Chainflip, NEAR Intents and others. Non-custodial — you sign every transaction with your own wallet.

cta.notConfiguredHelp: The wallet connect service isn't configured on this build. Set VITE_REOWN_PROJECT_ID to enable.
cta.connectHelp: Non-custodial — your keys, your coins. Connect MetaMask, WalletConnect, Phantom, or any supported wallet.

pay.title: Pay recipient
pay.subtitle: Send crypto to anyone in one step
pay.footnote: Non-custodial. A regulated provider collects the payment and delivers the crypto straight to the recipient — we never hold funds. Crypto transfers are final.

footer.tagline: © {{year}} OnRamp. Aggregator interface — providers handle custody and KYC.

landing.subtitle: Skip the signup. Compare top on-ramp providers in one place and get the industry's lowest fees with lightning-fast delivery directly to your wallet.

features.heading: Engineered for simplicity.
features.subheading: We've removed the barriers to entry, making it easier than ever to enter the world of decentralized finance.

noSignup.title: No Signup
noSignup.desc: Skip the account creation. Buy crypto in seconds — identity verification is handled securely by our trusted provider partners only when needed.

bestRates.title: Best Market Rates
bestRates.desc: Our smart-routing engine aggregates liquidity from top exchanges to ensure you always get the most for your money.

instant.title: Instant Delivery
instant.desc: No waiting periods. Once payment is confirmed, your digital assets are dispatched immediately to your private wallet.

crossChain.title: Cross-Chain Swaps
crossChain.desc: Swap any token across chains via THORChain, Chainflip and NEAR Intents. Non-custodial — your wallet signs every transaction.
